title: Ridge Circuit
brief: A time-trial racing game: drive three laps of a ridge circuit, crossing checkpoints in order, with a ghost of your best lap. GameState keeps lap, checkpoints, best_lap_ms and won, with lap counting up from one; set won to true after crossing the finish on lap three. Hitting a barrier costs speed but does not take the lap away.
artDirection: Sunset low-poly ridge road, clear apex markers, high-contrast car silhouette, dust and speed lines at the edges.

obligations.description: Driving through a checkpoint raises the count.
Finishing a circuit raises lap from its starting one.
Crossing the finish on lap three wins the time trial.
Checkpoints must be crossed in order; skipping one does not advance the lap.
obligations.unsupported: Ordering and skipped-element rejection need a route with ordered checkpoints; the vocabulary compares one scalar at a time and cannot say which of two crossings came first.
